Sleek ceramic-white hard-shell pressure suit, smooth segmented plates with a satin finish, articulated accordion joints at elbows and knees, broad gold mirror-visor helmet, soft cyan seam-lights tracing the ribs, one scuffed shoulder plate stamped with a faded chevron.

Bulky retro pressure suit, thick ribbed fabric limbs over a barrel-chested steel torso, fishbowl dome helmet with a fogged lower rim, amber faceplate cracked at the corner, copper cabling looped at the hip, deep carbon-scoring streaked down one arm.

Matte-black stealth EVA suit, slim form-fit composite plating, razor-thin magenta seam-glow tracing every panel edge, narrow angular T-visor reflecting nothing but starlight, integrated wrist console pulsing softly, micro-meteorite pocks freckling the chestplate.

Heavy armored military exo-suit, overlapping graphite plate panels, exposed hydraulic pistons at every joint, wide faceted faceplate over a sealed angular helm, twin hot-blue power-cells glowing at the lower back, reinforced gauntlets, battle-scarred and field-patched with mismatched bolts.

Battered deep-space salvage rig, dented ochre steel torso over quilted pressure bladder limbs, wide scratched polycarbonate bubble dome, amber ring-light glowing beneath the helm collar, heavy magnetic boot housings, entire left flank caked in grey regolith dust and thruster exhaust scoring.

Ornate ceremonial void-suit, ivory hard-shell plates with engraved stellar-cartography patterns, a swept-back helmet with a wide rose-gold mirror visor, gold filigree trim running the spinal ridge, a soft warm amber chest-sigil glowing beneath etched panel glass, pristine save for one hairline scratch across the sternum.

Transparent bubble-helm explorer suit, slim brushed-titanium body plating, a wide clear polycarbonate sphere seating the entire head, interior green HUD ring projected around the equator, minimalist white suit with a single electric-blue ventral seam-light, small thruster pods mounted symmetrically at each hip.

Organic bio-mechanical suit, matte bone-white carapace with rippled chitinous panel texture, softly bioluminescent violet vein-channels pulsing along the limbs, a teardrop helmet with a seamless smoked-amber lens, joint sections wrapped in dark rubbery membrane, subtle amber warning glow bleeding from a stress fracture along the collar.

Bright hazard-orange rescue suit, bulky rounded silhouette, reflective silver chevron stripes circling both arms and torso, a wide flat-faced helmet with a broad clear polycarbonate visor, twin red beacon strobes mounted at the shoulder, rescue tether anchor ring glowing faint white at the sternum.

Exoskeleton frame suit, bare lattice of brushed-steel structural rails over a skintight dark-grey pressure layer, exposed pneumatic pistons and colour-coded cabling at every joint, a compact angular helmet with a narrow amber visor slit, bright-white power-conduit running the spine, grease-stained and field-welded at several rail junctions.

Ablative re-entry suit, broad-shouldered ceramic-tile-paneled silhouette, underbelly plates heat-scarred to deep amber and black, a wide rounded helmet with a gold-tinted reinforced visor, orange thermal-warning strip glowing along the lower torso edge, tiles chipped and hairline-cracked from a recent shallow atmospheric pass.

Antique patchwork suit, mismatched panels of olive drab, silver, and rust-brown fabric-over-metal, a round goldfish-bowl helmet with a bolted replacement faceplate in different alloy, a single jury-rigged power-cell taped to the chest emitting a dim green glow, repair patches sewn and riveted across both knees and the left shoulder.

High-tech holographic-HUD suit, sleek anthracite composite shell, holographic readout panels projected outward from recessed emitters on the chest and forearms in pale blue-white light, a smooth wraparound visor with embedded data overlay grid, subtle silver pinstripe panel lines, a single cracked emitter housing leaking a stuttering ghost-image.

Slim white long-duration deep-exploration suit, elongated low-profile silhouette, micro-textured frost-white composite panels, a tall cylindrical helmet with a wide rectangular clear visor, soft teal power-ring glowing at the neck collar, extended life-support backpack module finned like a radiator, faint hairline scratches from long transit.

Vacuum-rated industrial mining suit, squat heavily reinforced silhouette, matte gunmetal composite over thick rubber-sealed joints, a low flat helmet with a wide polarised dark-grey visor, amber proximity-warning lights ringing the helmet base, drill-anchor points on both forearms, surfaces ground smooth by years of abrasive ore dust.

Elegant ultralight EVA suit, razor-slim brushed-silver composite panels, barely-there profile suggesting minimum bulk over the pressure layer, a sleek swept helmet with an iridescent full-face mirror visor shifting from gold to rose at oblique angles, hairline blue seam-lights, a single small embossed geometric emblem on the right breast.

Deep-navy cold-environment suit, thickly insulated rounded silhouette with quilted exterior panels, a broad spherical helmet with a heated double-pane clear visor rimmed in frost, electric-blue thermal-coil stripes glowing along the outer thighs and upper arms, oversized gloves with articulated rigid knuckle plates, rime ice crystals still clinging to the boot housings.

Modular reconfigurable suit, blocky segmented torso of interchangeable charcoal-grey hard panels locked by visible twist-ring collars, a helmet with a broad rectangular flip-up visor in amber, swappable tool-mount rail glowing cool white along the left forearm, one panel swapped for a mismatched dark-green replacement, wiring harness visible at the swap seam.

Stealth-grey long-range recon suit, form-hugging matte graphite composite, all panel edges chamfered to reduce radar cross-section, a narrow horizontal visor slit glowing a dim red, no external cabling or protruding hardware, a single recessed chest power-cell pulsing deep crimson, micro-pitting across the helmet crown from high-velocity debris.

Ceremonial jet-black diplomatic void-suit, polished obsidian lacquered hard-shell, flared pauldrons with subtle silver inlay constellation maps, a wide convex mirror visor tinted deep violet, soft white under-lighting bleeding from the boot soles and wrist cuffs, entirely unmarred save for a tiny pressure-test stamp on the inner left wrist plate.

Cobalt-blue science survey suit, mid-bulk composite shell with distinct modular sensor housings bolted to both forearms and the upper chest, a wide domed transparent helmet with a projected cyan data-ring around its interior equator, white panel trim, a faint star-chart laser etched across the upper chest plate, one sensor housing cracked and dark.

Tangerine-and-white classic-era pressure suit, puffy fabric-over-bladder construction with prominent ribbed bellows joints, a chrome-ringed fishbowl helmet, wide clear polycarbonate dome, reflective white torso with tangerine limbs, a bright LED checklist-strip glowing green on the left forearm cuff, an old mission patch sewn crookedly on the right bicep.

Pearl-white lightweight EVA suit with a sweeping organic silhouette, smooth flowing panel transitions rather than hard edges, a teardrop-shaped helmet with a single wide gold mirror visor lens, barely visible rose-pink seam lighting along the shoulder yoke, a micro-thruster cluster at the small of the back glowing faint amber at idle.

Weathered long-haul freighter suit, faded olive-drab composite torso shell over heavily patched grey pressure-fabric limbs, a boxy rectangular helmet with a scratched amber polycarbonate visor, a third-party replacement life-support unit zip-tied and bolted to the back in mismatched silver, dim orange chest telemetry panel flickering at the lower-left corner.

Matte-sand desert-world EVA suit, wide heat-reflective panels in pale khaki composite, a broad low-profile helmet with a polarised amber full-face visor, white reflective strips across the shoulders, coolant-loop tubing visible at the wrist and ankle cuffs glowing a faint pulsing aqua, surfaces lightly sandblasted and one knee plate replaced in contrasting bright white.
